what: Each site trains the same network alone, on its own train days only, from the same initial weights.

target.metric: AUROC on the frozen test days for the failure family the site rarely sees (Site A: y_mobility, Site B: y_congestion), local-only model
target.direction: expected local-only value; the federated model must beat it for the federation to count as a gain

grader: ran-fl/aws/eval_job.py (deterministic script, no model; AUROC, validation-tuned F1, 60-minute lead recall)
